page.overview:
Who is Annika Svennson?

Annika Svennson is a summonable vision and optional playable character in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. She serves as a cameo character representing Square Enix's video game series, Just Cause 3.

Annika Svennson's Trust Master reward is the passive special ability Distraction which increases HP by 20% and enables the use of Firestarter.

She also won't hesitate to raise her prices for any jobs that are overly demanding.|4★ - No. 8156|A mercenary from another world fighting against the dictator of Medici. Annika is the leader of a gang of smugglers until she loses her crew to Di Ravello, the very dictator she opposes.|5★ - No. 8157|A mercenary from another world fighting against the dictator of Medici. Annika and Teo join the Rebellion as mercenaries and aid Rico Rodriguez on his mission to liberate Medici. On one of their missions together, she finds her old crew and Rico lends a hand with their rescue.|context=Entries for different versions of Annika Svennson.}}

Annika Svennson is a 3-5★ limited-Time Summon, whose job is listed as Mercenary, and her role is Physical Attacker. She has no innate element or status ailment resistances.
